problems: The proposal attributes whole-hypothalamus sampling to GEO. Whole hypothalamus is the registry label. The manuscript describes dissected hypothalami, and the GSM source names specify Hypothalamus slice. The 14 library identities and treatment groups still match.

The proposal mentions the P-value axis and the DESeq2 method but leaves the conflict implicit. Figure 2A shows cutoffs near −log10(Pvalue) = 1.30 and log2FC ±0.3. The written rule uses BH-adjusted P < 0.05 and logFold > 0.3. Counting the authors’ 65 reported DEGs is justified, but assigning individual author FDR calls or attributing the difference from the three registered discoveries to a particular method would require the original results or selection code.
